budget_items.what_was_recorded: An $800 donation was accepted into the gift account for STEM supplies.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $1000 anonymous check was accepted to help students going to Nature's Classroom in October 2025.
budget_items.quote: we also have a check for $1000 from an anonymous donor

budget_items.quote: a transfer in the amount of $19,600 from computer purchase and lease line to the equipment maintenance and lease line

budget_items.quote: second line item transfer request of $5,000 moving from the fire safety furniture repair line to the vehicle maintenance repair line

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $311,041.69 transfer from the school salary reserve line to multiple salary lines.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The tech department switched vendors for Chromebook screen parts and prices rose 54% due to tariffs.
budget_items.quote: the prices went up 54% due to tariffs

budget_items.topic: Bagged lunch price at town meeting
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The food service program would sell bagged lunches at town meeting for $8, cash and carry only.
budget_items.quote: offering bagged lunches, cost will be $8 and be available between 11 and 1, cash and carry only

budget_items.topic: House Ways and Means minimum school aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The House Ways and Means budget would raise minimum aid to schools from $75 to $150 per student; the speaker noted it could change in the Senate.
budget_items.quote: their budget has a minimum aid to school raising from the $75 per student to $150

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public comment noted a potential 75% reimbursement of required out-of-district placements that could change.
budget_items.quote: there is also potential for 75% of all required out of district placement eligible for reimbursement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The House bill allocates a one-time $1.3 billion from the FY24 fair share amendments tax surplus, as printed.
budget_items.quote: it allocates a one-time 1.3 billion fy24 fair share amendments tax surplus

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The bill provides 100% reimbursement for FY25 regional transportation, up from 82%.
budget_items.quote: key provisions to the bill were a full 100% reimbursement for fy25 regional transportation up from 82%

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The bill provides a 75% circuit breaker reimbursement for out-of-district special education transportation, increased from 44%.
budget_items.quote: a 75% reimbursement increased from 44% for fy out of district special education transportation cost through circuit breaker

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Representative Kushmerek and Scarsdale reported $50,000 in earmarks for Lunenburg Public Schools; the select board chair said the same.
budget_items.quote: there are $50,000 in earmarks for lunenburg public schools

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee discussed the FY 26 budget, position cuts and unemployment costs, and a memo on how free cash would be spent; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the committee discusses the fy 26 budget, position cuts, unemployment costs.
